output.answer: One thing worth saying plainly: I write Node.js APIs in Fastify, not NestJS, so the framework would be new to me. ledger-lite, my small bookkeeping API on GitHub, shows how I'd approach the Core API work. It pushes the rule that debits and credits must balance down into PostgreSQL with a deferred constraint, so a careless script can't skip it. I'm in Lahore, inside the time-zone window the posting gives.
